offering_description.value: Sells shelf-stable and frozen packaged foods, spices, condiments and snacks under its own brands, made in its plants or by co-packers. Customers are grocery, mass, club and dollar retailers, plus foodservice and food distributors across North America.

primary_products.value: shelf-stable vegetables and beans; frozen vegetables; spices and seasonings; condiments and sauces; baking mixes; snacks

customer_segment.value: B2B: grocery and mass retailers, club stores, dollar stores, foodservice operators, food distributors

end_markets.value: grocery retail; foodservice; food distribution; export

revenue_model.value: product sales: branded packaged food sold to retailers, distributors and foodservice customers

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: owns and markets its branded food portfolio, sold to retailers and distributors; OEM / manufacturer: produces foods in its own plants and through co-packers, sold to retail and foodservice customers

geography_served.value: North America: United States nationwide, with sales in Canada and some export markets

specialization.value: related lines: shelf-stable and frozen vegetables, spices, condiments, baking and snack lines sold to the same grocery channel

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: national grocery and mass retail accounts; distributors / dealers: food distributors and foodservice distributors; third-party retail: grocery, club, dollar and convenience stores; online: retailer e-commerce sites
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; third-party retail; online

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: FDA food safety, labeling and nutrition rules, plus USDA and Canadian food standards

notes: Brand portfolio and plant footprint change over time through divestitures, so details may be out of date.
